ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/cream pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted against a low-intensity black margin along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a contiguous high-intensity white/cream blob. Dark pigmentation (black) forms a continuous border along the trailing edge. Distinct small dark focal spots are visible on the mid-right lobe and left-central region. Yellow-brown pixel clusters (diatom staining) are concentrated in the lower-central and left-central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with a calculated wide angle (approx. 135 degrees) and minimal bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire boundary; the left lobe displays higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys (jagged profile) compared to the more uniform right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge, transitioning to sharp, slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast texture clusters (white and black) located on the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jaggedness and potential minor tissue loss along the trailing edge margin; significant yellow-brown organic film (diatom accumulation) across the central-lower fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pattern of small dark circular spots on the right lobe surface and prominent central bio-fouling staining.
